querystring.select: SELECT C.CUST_NO AS CustNo, C.CUST_NAME AS CustName, RMMOD.DESCR AS CustModel,  C.TAX_ID_NO AS Npwp, RMTYPE.DESCR AS CoyType
querystring.from: FROM dbo.CUST AS C WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN dbo.CUST_COMPANY CP WITH(NOLOCK) ON C.CUST_ID = CP.CUST_ID   LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMID WITH(NOLOCK) ON RMID.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = 'ID_TYPE' AND RMID.MASTER_CODE = C.MR_ID_TYPE_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMMOD WITH(NOLOCK) ON RMMOD.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE='CUST_MODEL' AND C.MR_CUST_MODEL_CODE = RMMOD.MASTER_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMTYPE WITH(NOLOCK) ON RMTYPE.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE='COMPANY_TYPE' AND CP.MR_COMPANY_TYPE_CODE = RMTYPE.MASTER_CODE
